fact: Kenya's National Treasury said in August 2025 that from that month-end it would pay salaries and pensions of civil servants and former officials through the Integrated Personnel Payroll Database (IPPD), extending the 1998 system to pensioners.

Kenya's State Department for Social Protection began migrating all Inua Jamii beneficiaries to the eCitizen-M-Pesa payment platform from the January 2025 disbursement, with funds collected from M-Pesa agents through USSD *222#.
The State Department requires every Inua Jamii beneficiary to hold a registered Safaricom line that matches their ID card to receive funds.

The Kenyan government's State Department for Social Protection pays Inua Jamii cash-transfer stipends (older persons, orphans and vulnerable children, severe disability, plus HSNP) into bank accounts through six contracted payment service providers, monthly from July 2023.
The government mandated mobile money payments from December 2023, piloted for the CT-OVC and PwSD-CT programmes to augment bank payments.
